name: awesome-production-machine-learning
desc: A curated list of awesome open source libraries to deploy, monitor, version and scale your machine learning

resources.name: Bread Dataset Viewer
resources.desc: A VS Code extension for viewing and exploring large machine learning datasets (CSV, JSON, Parquet, etc.) directly within the editor without the IDE crashing.

resources.name: Bread WandB Viewer
resources.desc: A VS Code extension to view Weights & Biases experiments, logs, and artifacts within the IDE, eliminating the need to switch to the web UI & preserving data privacy by being 100% offline.

resources.name: NNEF
resources.desc: Neural Network Exchange Format (NNEF) is an open standard for representing neural network models to enable interoperability and portability across different machine learning frameworks and platforms.

resources.name: PFA
resources.desc: PFA (Portable Format for Analytics) format is a standard for representing and exchanging predictive models and analytics workflows in a portable, JSON-based format.

resources.name: PMML
resources.desc: PMML (Predictive Model Markup Language) is an XML-based standard for representing and sharing predictive models between different applications.
